paper_id: IRCoCo_ Immediate Rewards-Guided Deep Reinforcement Learning for Code Completion
title: IRCoCo: Immediate Rewards-Guided Deep Reinforcement Learning for Code Completion
motivation: SFT的teacher-forcing策略导致暴露偏差，错误逐token累积
problem_framing: 代码补全的context动态变化且无法用单元测试评估partial code
key_insight: 为每个生成的token提供即时reward，让模型感知context的实时变化
method_signature: Actor-Critic框架，Actor为预训练LM，Critic为BLEU/Edit-Sim训练的评估器
evaluation_criteria: Edit-Sim, EM, BLEU-4, CodeBLEU四项指标
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: BLEU/Edit-Sim只看表面匹配，不捕捉代码语义，等价表达式被错误标记
evidence_for_taste: reward redistribution-based strategies cannot be adapted to code completion
This approach fails to capture the nuanced alterations
the model fails to allocate rewards during intermediate states
such exact match-based metrics overlook the semantics of code
thinking_moves: 把code completion的动态context变化类比为RL中的state变化
用critic网络把sparse delayed reward转化为dense immediate reward
